scale_source: station baseline from tour-manifest.json GPS coordinates

cross_checks.shape_note: Scale-free: a ratio of two reconstructed lengths, so the unknown baseline scale cancels. This is testable without any assumed reference, unlike the absolute dimensions. 0.385 implies the rig sat at ~1.04 m in a 2.7 m room or ~1.16 m in a 3.0 m room - well below the 1.50 m the monocular pipeline assumes.
cross_checks.note: Diagnostics only - these do NOT set scale. Disagreement with ~1.50 m / ~2.15 m indicates a scale or capture-geometry problem.

dimensions.pilaster_bump_note: |-1.3 cm| is below the 1.8 cm median ray residual; pilaster and alcove are the same plane within noise.
